extracted text: The paper investigates the effects of microporosity variation on the impact properties of a low-pressure die-cast A356 aluminum alloy. The study compares as-cast and T6-treated conditions with various solution treatment times (1, 3, 6, and 12 hours at 540°C) and artificial aging times (1, 4, 16, and 48 hours at 160°C). From Table 3, hardness values (HRF) for different conditions are: as-cast (69.8), after 3h solution + 16h aging (88.3), after 6h solution + 16h aging (89.8), after 12h solution + 16h aging (88.4).
